primitives.title: Define 3-Year Consolidated P&L Structure and Assumptions Pack
primitives.objective: Establish the standardized consolidated P&L layout (monthly or quarterly), consolidation rules, accounting policy assumptions, and scenario parameters required for simulation and Command Center intake.
primitives.capability: Financial model design, consolidation logic definition, assumption governance
acceptance: P&L structure includes at minimum: Revenue, COGS, Gross Profit, Gross Margin %, SG&A (with logistics as a distinct line), Other OpEx, EBITDA, EBITDA Margin %, D&A, EBIT, Interest, Taxes, Net Income
Time horizon covers 3 full years with consistent periodicity (explicitly stated) and totals/subtotals are internally consistent

Assumptions pack includes: currency, units, revenue recognition approach, COGS drivers, SG&A allocation approach, EBITDA adjustment policy, and consolidation treatment (entities/segments, intercompany eliminations if applicable)

## P01 Deliverable — 3-Year Consolidated P&L Structure + Assumptions Pack (for simulation + SOSE Command Center intake)

### Evidence (what this output contains per Acceptance)
- **Standardized consolidated P&L layout** defined with required lines: Revenue, COGS, Gross Profit, Gross Margin %, SG&A (incl. distinct **Logistics** line), Other OpEx, EBITDA, EBITDA Margin %, D&A, EBIT, Interest, Taxes, Net Income.
- **3 full years** with **explicit periodicity**: **Quarterly** (12 periods: Y1Q1…Y3Q4).
- **Internal consistency rules** (subtotals/totals) specified as formulas.
- **Assumptions pack** defined as a dedicated tab and designed to be referenced by formulas (no magic numbers in the P&L output rows).
- **Scenarios**: Baseline + at least one stress/variant covering **gross margin compression** and **unexpected logistics SG&A spikes**.
- **Consolidation treatment**: segments/entities, allocation logic, and intercompany eliminations specified.

---

### Assumptions
- You want a **quarterly** view (Command Center intake-friendly) rather than monthly; can be switched to monthly by expanding the period index.
- Consolidation includes **multiple segments/entities** and supports **intercompany eliminations**.
- EBITDA adjustments are tracked as **separate lines below EBITDA (Reported)** and/or as **bridge items** (policy defined below). If your intake gate requires a different EBITDA presentation (e.g., Adjusted EBITDA only), that is a configurable output view.

---

### Unresolved gaps (need confirmation later, not required to define structure)
- Number and names of legal entities vs operating segments (I provide a template approach with placeholders).
- Tax regime detail (flat effective tax rate assumed in template).
- Interest calculation method (flat rate on average debt assumed in template).
- Any specific SOSE field naming constraints (I use standard labels; can map later).

---

# Workbook Design (Tabs / Sheets)

## 1) `ASSUMP` (Dedicated assumptions pack — single source of truth)
**Purpose:** All drivers live here; P&L sheets reference by formula using `XLOOKUP`/`INDEX-MATCH` by Scenario + Period.

### A. Global controls
- `Currency` (e.g., USD)
- `Units` (e.g., $ in thousands)
- `Periodicity` = Quarterly
- `StartPeriod` = Y1Q1
- `Periods` = 12
- `Scenario` selector (data validation): `Baseline`, `Stress_MarginLogistics`

### B. Revenue recognition approach (policy)
- `RevRecPolicy` (text): “Accrual; revenue recognized on transfer of control; returns estimated via reserve; intercompany revenue eliminated on consolidation.”
- Optional: `%ReturnsReserve` by period/scenario (driver table)

### C. Revenue drivers (by Segment/Entity)
Table: `RevenueDriver`
- Keys: `Scenario`, `Segment`, `Period`
- Fields (example driver options; choose one approach for your build):
  - `StartingRevenue` (for Y1Q1 only)
  - `QoQ_GrowthRate`
  - `Price_Mix_Impact`
  - `Volume_Impact`
  - (or simply `Revenue_Override` if you want direct control)

### D. COGS drivers + gross margin compression parameters
Table: `COGSDriver`
- Keys: `Scenario`, `Segment`, `Period`
- Fields:
  - `Base_COGS_Pct_of_Revenue` (or base gross margin %)
  - `InputCostInflation`
  - `Freight_In_COGS_Pct` (if applicable)
  - **`GM_Compression_bps`** (stress lever; can be 0 in baseline)
  - `COGS_Override` (optional)

**Gross margin compression point definition (for simulation):**
- Compression is applied as an **increase to COGS %** (or decrease to GM%) for specified periods.
- Store as `GM_Compression_bps` (e.g., +150 bps in Y2Q3–Y2Q4).

### E. SG&A drivers with Logistics isolated + spike parameters
Table: `SGADriver`
- Keys: `Scenario`, `Segment`, `Period`
- Fields:
  - `SGA_Base_Pct_of_Revenue`
  - `Logistics_Base_Pct_of_Revenue` (distinct line)
  - **`Logistics_Spike_Amount`** (absolute) and/or **`Logistics_Spike_Pct`**
  - `HeadcountCostIndex` (optional)
  - `SGA_Override` (optional)
  - `Logistics_Override` (optional)

**Unexpected SG&A spike definition:**
- Implement as **additive** to logistics SG&A for certain periods (e.g., port disruption in Y3Q1).

### F. Other OpEx, D&A, Interest, Taxes
Tables:
- `OtherOpexDriver`: `%Revenue` or absolute
- `DADriver`: absolute per period, or % of PP&E (if you track PP&E elsewhere)
- `DebtDriver`: `AvgDebt`, `InterestRate`
- `TaxDriver`: `EffectiveTaxRate` (flat by scenario or period)

### G. EBITDA adjustment policy (required)
Table: `EBITDA_Adjustments`
- Keys: `Scenario`, `Period`, `AdjType`
- Fields:
  - `AdjAmount` (positive adds back to EBITDA; negative subtracts)
  - `AdjPolicyFlag` (Allowed/NotAllowed)
  - `Notes`

**Policy text (in ASSUMP):**
- “Adjusted EBITDA excludes: one-time restructuring, non-recurring legal settlement, acquisition-related transaction costs, impairment, non-cash stock comp (if policy permits). Adjustments must be tagged by type and period; all adjustments are included in an ‘EBITDA Adjustments’ line and optionally bridged to ‘Adjusted EBITDA’.”

### H. Consolidation treatment (required)
Table: `Consolidation`
- Entities/segments list: `SegmentA`, `SegmentB`, `SegmentC` (placeholders)
- `Ownership%` (if partial ownership)
- `FunctionalCurrency` (if multi-currency; else blank)
- Intercompany:
  - `IC_Sales_%` or `IC_Sales_Amount`
  - `IC_COGS_%` or `IC_COGS_Amount`
  - Rule: eliminate IC revenue and IC COGS at consolidation.

---

## 2) `P&L_SEG` (Segment-level calculation layer; optional but recommended)
**Purpose:** compute each segment P&L per period per scenario.

Columns:
- `Scenario`, `Segment`, `Period` (Y1Q1…Y3Q4)

Rows (minimum set):
1. Revenue
2. COGS
3. Gross Profit
4. Gross Margin %
5. SG&A – Logistics
6. SG&A – Other
7. SG&A Total
8. Other OpEx
9. EBITDA (Reported)
10. EBITDA Adjustments (total)
11. EBITDA (Adjusted) *(if required by intake)*
12. D&A
13. EBIT
14. Interest
15. Taxes
16. Net Income

**Formula conventions (examples; Excel pseudo-formulas):**
- Revenue (segment):
  - `=PrevPeriodRevenue*(1+XLOOKUP(Scenario&Segment&Period,RevenueDriver[Key],RevenueDriver[QoQ_GrowthRate]))`
  - or `=XLOOKUP(...,RevenueDriver[Revenue_Override])` if override present
- COGS:
  - `=Revenue * (Base_COGS_Pct + GM_Compression_bps/10000) * (1+InputCostInflation)`
- Gross Profit:
  - `=Revenue-COGS`
- GM%:
  - `=GrossProfit/Revenue`
- Logistics SG&A:
  - `=Revenue*Logistics_Base_Pct + Logistics_Spike_Amount + Revenue*Logistics_Spike_Pct`
- SG&A Other:
  - `=Revenue*(SGA_Base_Pct - Logistics_Base_Pct)` *(if total SGA pct includes logistics)* or separately driven
- EBITDA (Reported):
  - `=GrossProfit - SGA_Total - OtherOpEx`
- EBITDA Adjustments:
  - `=SUMIFS(EBITDA_Adjustments[AdjAmount], Scenario, Period)`
- EBITDA (Adjusted):
  - `=EBITDA_Reported + EBITDA_Adjustments`
- EBIT:
  - `=EBITDA_Reported - D&A` *(or use adjusted, depending on reporting policy; define explicitly)*
- Interest:
  - `=AvgDebt*InterestRate/4` *(quarterly)*
- Taxes:
  - `=MAX(0, (EBT)*EffectiveTaxRate)` *(if you want no tax benefit on losses; policy choice)*
- Net Income:
  - `=EBT - Taxes`

---

## 3) `P&L_CONSOL` (Consolidated output — the intake-facing sheet)
**Purpose:** a single standardized consolidated P&L statement, scenario-selectable.

### Layout (required lines + totals)
Columns:
- Periods: `Y1Q1 … Y3Q4`, plus `Y1 Total`, `Y2 Total`, `Y3 Total` (optional but recommended)

Rows (exact minimum acceptance list; you can add detail beneath):
1. **Revenue**
2. **COGS**
3. **Gross Profit**
4. **Gross Margin %**
5. **SG&A – Logistics** *(distinct)*
6. **SG&A – Other**
7. **SG&A Total**
8. **Other OpEx**
9. **EBITDA (Reported)**
10. **EBITDA Margin %**
11. **EBITDA Adjustments** *(policy-defined)*
12. **EBITDA (Adjusted)** *(if required; else keep as supplemental)*
13. **D&A**
14. **EBIT**
15. **Interest**
16. **Taxes**
17. **Net Income**

### Consolidation formulas (conceptual)
- Revenue (Consol):
  - `=SUMIFS(P&L_SEG[Revenue], Scenario, SelectedScenario, Period, ThisPeriod) - IC_Revenue_Elim`
- COGS (Consol):
  - `=SUMIFS(P&L_SEG[COGS], ...) - IC_COGS_Elim`
- IC eliminations sourced from `ASSUMP` (either direct amounts or % applied):
  - `IC_Revenue_Elim = SUM(IC_Sales_Amount by period)` or `=SUM(Revenue*IC_Sales_% )`
  - Same for IC COGS
- Subtotals:
  - Gross Profit = Revenue – COGS
  - SG&A Total = Logistics + Other
  - EBITDA (Reported) = Gross Profit – SG&A Total – Other OpEx
  - EBITDA Margin % = EBITDA / Revenue
  - EBIT = EBITDA – D&A
  - Net Income = (EBIT – Interest) – Taxes

**Internal consistency rule:** every subtotal is calculated, not typed.

---

# Scenario Parameters (minimum: Baseline + 1 Stress)

## Scenario 1: `Baseline`
- GM_Compression_bps = 0 for all periods.
- Logistics_Spike_Amount = 0 for all periods.
- Growth, COGS%, SG&A%, Other OpEx% set to steady-state assumptions.

## Scenario 2: `Stress_MarginLogistics`
Designed to create visible “compression points” and “spikes”:
- **Gross margin compression:** set `GM_Compression_bps` > 0 in specific quarters (example pattern):
  - Y2Q2–Y2Q4: +100 to +250 bps (input-cost shock)
- **Unexpected logistics spike:** set `Logistics_Spike_Amount` (or % revenue) in a discrete quarter (example):
  - Y3Q1: one-time +$X (port disruption / expedited freight / carrier surcharge)
- EBITDA adjustments: add one or more adjustment types (example):
  - Y2Q3: restructuring add-back
  - Y3Q2: legal settlement add-back (or disallowed per policy—flagged)

All the above live in `ASSUMP` tables and are pulled into the P&L via lookups.

---

# Implementation Notes (to ensure “no magic numbers”)
- P&L sheets should only contain:
  - **Lookups to `ASSUMP`** (scenario/period/segment keyed)
  - Arithmetic combining those drivers
- Any direct values entered on P&L lines should be limited to labels or formatting—not amounts.

---

## Ready-for-Intake Checklist (P01)
- [ ] Period axis: 12 quarters (Y1Q1–Y3Q4) clearly labeled
- [ ] Scenario selector in `ASSUMP` and reflected in `P&L_CONSOL`
- [ ] Required P&L lines present exactly (or superset)
- [ ] Consolidation logic documented (segments, eliminations)
- [ ] EBITDA adjustment policy + table of adjustments by period
- [ ] Gross margin compression and logistics spike drivers parameterized by scenario/period
- [ ] Subtotals are formula-driven; no hard-coded totals

---

If you provide the intended **segment list**, **currency/units**, and whether you want **EBIT based on Reported vs Adjusted EBITDA**, I can refine the assumption field names to match your SOSE intake schema—but that would be a subsequent primitive, not part of P01.

   • Litigation settlements (non-recurring)
   • Insurance recoveries (>$500K)
   • Criteria: Outside ordinary course of business
